attackers_goals: Adversaries continuously find and develop new undetectable, novel methods of launching malware during startup. Attackers aim to get persistence to continue operating even after a reboot.
description: Uncommon execution of an executable found in an early startup stage.
investigative_actions: Check if the CGO (causality group owner) is familiar and if one of it configuration/parameters/registry keys has been modified.
